title: Seoul City Tour Bus (Tiger Bus) 2026: Routes, Stops, Prices, Night Tour and Tickets
description: Seoul City Tour Bus guide, checked October 2026: the 15-stop Downtown, Palaces & Namsan hop-on hop-off course, the Han River night tour, prices from KRW 27,000, Monday closures and where to board at Gwanghwamun.
h1Sub: Routes, prices, night tour and where to board
lead: The Seoul City Tour Bus (run by Tiger Bus) has left from Gwanghwamun since 2000. By day it loops past Gyeongbokgung Palace, Myeong-dong and N Seoul Tower on a hop-on hop-off course; at night a 90-minute tour crosses the Han River bridges and stops at Namsan.

booking.label: Book on the official Seoul City Tour Bus site

summary: Gwanghwamun ticket office, 100 m from Gwanghwamun Station (Line 5) exit 6
Downtown, Palaces & Namsan · 15 stops · departures 09:20–16:50 every 25 min · about 1 h 30 min per loop
Han River & Namsan · 19:00 (19:30 May–Aug) · about 90 min
Day from KRW 27,000 (adult) / KRW 19,000 (child) · Night from KRW 25,000 / KRW 16,000
Every Monday (if Monday is a public holiday it runs and closes Tuesday)

routes.name: Downtown, Palaces & Namsan course
stops: Gyeongbokgung Palace / National Folk Museum / MMCA
routes.tip: The ticket is valid for that day only, and you can get on and off at the 15 stops as often as you like. The last bus leaves Gwanghwamun at 16:50 and returns at 18:20, so check the time before getting off at N Seoul Tower or Dongdaemun.

night.time: 19:00 once a day (19:30 from 1 May to 31 Aug)
night.start: Gwanghwamun ticket office (boarding from 40 min before)
night.duration: about 90 min (about 25 min stop at N Seoul Tower)
night.price: Adult from KRW 25,000 · child from KRW 16,000
night.text: The night course leaves Gwanghwamun, crosses Mapo, Hangang, Dongjak, Banpo, Seongsu and Hannam bridges, stops at N Seoul Tower for about 25 minutes and ends at Cheonggye Plaza via Sungnyemun. N Seoul Tower is its only stop.

tickets.name: Day course (Downtown, Palaces & Namsan)
tickets.price: Adult from KRW 27,000 (KRW 36,000 list) · child from KRW 19,000
tickets.for: Palaces, Myeong-dong and Namsan in a day

tickets.name: Night course (Han River & Namsan)
tickets.price: Adult from KRW 25,000 (KRW 29,000 list) · child from KRW 16,000
includes: About 25 min at N Seoul Tower

priceNote: Prices are the discounted (from) and list prices shown on the official site on 28 October 2026. Children are 48 months to high-school age. Prices change by date, so check the final amount when booking.
howToBook: Open the official site with the button below and choose a course.
Pick the date and number of people and pay. Online booking closes the day before you ride.
To ride the same day, buy a ticket at the Gwanghwamun ticket office without booking.
howToRide: Walk 100 m from Gwanghwamun Station (Line 5) exit 6, or about 300 m from City Hall Station (Lines 1 and 2) exit 3, to the Gwanghwamun ticket office.
Give the name on your booking at the ticket office and collect your boarding pass.
Show the pass to the driver when you board. Seats are first come, first served.
The audio guide is available in 12 languages; ask at the ticket office if you need earphones.
Get off at any of the 15 stops and catch the next bus, which comes every 25 minutes.

faq.q: Can I ride the Seoul City Tour Bus without booking?
faq.a: Yes. Same-day tickets cannot be bought online; buy them at the Gwanghwamun ticket office. For the night course it is worth calling 02-777-6090 to check seats first.

faq.q: Where do I board the Seoul City Tour Bus?
faq.a: At the Gwanghwamun ticket office, 100 m from Gwanghwamun Station (Line 5) exit 6 and about 300 m from City Hall Station exit 3.
No, it is closed every Monday. If Monday is a public holiday it runs and closes on Tuesday instead.

faq.q: Is there an English audio guide?
faq.a: Yes. The day course has an audio guide in 12 languages, including English.

faq.q: Can I choose an open-top double-decker?
faq.a: No. The bus type (open-top double-decker, glass-top double-decker or single-deck) is assigned on the day.
